Summary of websites posted in 'general':
1) www.informations.com: The latest job report brought a mix of relief and concern as unemployment edged down to 7.2%.
2) www.restaurant-zurich.com: Zurich Restaurant is a cozy, alpine-inspired eatery in the city center known for authentic Swiss cuisine (cheese fondue, rösti, chocolate fondue). It has warm wooden interiors with Swiss memorabilia, panoramic city skyline views, and staff in traditional Swiss attire.

Hi Dora! I visited your website. It's clean and simple, and the contact email is easy to find. To make it stronger, consider adding more about who you are and what you do, such as a short bio, projects, or a portfolio. A bit of visual styling and navigation would also help.

Hi Eve! I enjoyed your blog. Opening with your love of hiking gives it a personal, friendly feel. To improve it, you could add posts about specific hikes, such as photos, trail details, and tips. Categories or a post archive would also make it easier to browse.
